sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Ms. Vijeta Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. appearing for the State respondents.

This writ petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report dated 2.12.2022 registered as Case Crime no. 357 of 2022, under Section 498A, 328, 354, 376, 323, 504,
506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Tharwai, District Prayagraj.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

At the very outset, Ms. Vijeta Singh holding brief of Sri Shashank Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that in the present case Final Report No. 12 of 2023 dated 29.1.2023 has Santosh Mishra And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88911230/
1 already been submitted and the present petition has become infructuous.
